lessons.name: Uy hayvoni va yovvoyi hayvon
lessons.goal: Bola uy hayvoni va yovvoyi hayvonni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ba'zi hayvonlar odam bilan birga yashaydi, ba'zilari esa o'rmonda o'zi yashaydi. Qaysi biri qayerda? Keling, bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A cow and a dog next to a farmhouse, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uy hayvonlari odam yonida yashaydi. Odam ularga ovqat beradi, ular esa bizga yordam beradi: sigir sut beradi, it uyni qo'riqlaydi.

items.image_prompt: Wild animal paw prints leading into a forest, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yovvoyi hayvonlar o'rmonda, tog'da yoki dalada o'zi yashaydi. Ular ovqatini o'zi topadi. Ularga yaqin bormaymiz!

extra.matn: O'yin! Men hayvon aytaman. Uy hayvoni bo'lsa — qo'llaringiz bilan tom yasang. Yovvoyi bo'lsa — daraxtdek qo'lni ko'taring! It… Sigir…

lessons.name: O'rmonda kim yashaydi
lessons.goal: Bola ayiq, bo'ri, tulkini taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men o'rmon ustidan uchib o'tdim va uchta yovvoyi hayvonni ko'rdim. Biri katta, biri kulrang, biri ayyor. Kimlar ekan?

items.image_prompt: A big brown bear in the forest, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ayiq. U katta va kuchli, «o'-o'» deb o'kiradi. Ayiq asal va rezavorlarni yaxshi ko'radi.

items.image_prompt: A grey wolf howling at the moon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bo'ri. U kulrang, dumi uzun. Kechasi oyga qarab «uv-uv-uuu» deb uvillaydi. Bo'rilar to'da bo'lib yuradi.

items.image_prompt: A red fox with a fluffy tail, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — tulki. U qizg'ish rangda, dumi paxmoq va chiroyli. Ertaklarda tulki ayyor bo'ladi!

lessons.name: Uy hayvonlarining bolalari
lessons.goal: Bola buzoq, qo'zichoq, kuchukcha, toychoqni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Hamma hayvonlarning ham bolalari bor. Sigirning bolasini nima deymiz? Keling, topamiz!

items.image_prompt: A cute baby calf, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — buzoq, sigirning bolasi. U onasining sutini ichadi va «mo'o» deb chaqiradi. Buzoq katta bo'lsa, sigir bo'ladi.

items.image_prompt: A little fluffy lamb, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — qo'zichoq, qo'yning bolasi. U juda kichkina va yumshoq, ingichka ovozda «ba-a» deydi.

items.image_prompt: A playful puppy, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kuchukcha, itning bolasi. U o'ynoqi, «vov» deb vovillaydi va to'p quvib o'ynaydi.

items.image_prompt: A young foal with long legs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — toychoq, otning bolasi. Uning oyoqlari uzun-uzun. Toychoq tug'ilgach, tezda turib yura boshlaydi!

extra.matn: O'yin! Men bolani aytaman, siz onasini aytasiz. Buzoq — … sigir! Kuchukcha — … it! Qo'zichoq — … qo'y! Toychoq — … ot! Barakalla!

lessons.name: Hayvonot bog'ida
lessons.goal: Bola sher, fil, maymunni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun hayvonot bog'iga sayohatga boramiz. U yerda issiq o'lkalardan kelgan hayvonlar bor. Kimni ko'ramiz?

items.image_prompt: A lion with a big golden mane, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — sher. Uni «hayvonlar shohi» deymiz. Sherning boshida qalin yoli bor va u «r-r-r» deb o'kiradi.

items.image_prompt: A big grey elephant with a long trunk, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — fil. U eng katta quruqlik hayvoni! Filning uzun xartumi bor, u bilan suv ichadi va o'zini cho'miltiradi.

items.image_prompt: A playful monkey hanging from a branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — maymun. U daraxtdan daraxtga sakraydi va quvnoq «u-u-a-a» deydi. Maymun banan yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.

extra.matn: Harakatli o'yin: fil bo'lamiz — og'ir qadam, xartum silkitamiz! Maymun bo'lamiz — sakraymiz! Sher bo'lamiz — r-r-r! Zo'r!

lessons.name: Qushlar
lessons.goal: Bola chumchuq, kabutar, boyqushni taniydi, qushning qanoti borligini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men ham qushman! Qushlarning qanoti va pati bor, ular uchadi. Bugun do'stlarim bilan tanishtiraman!

items.image_prompt: A small brown sparrow on a branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — chumchuq. U kichkina va kulrang-jigarrang. «Chirq-chirq» deb sakrab yuradi va don teradi.

items.image_prompt: A friendly grey pigeon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kabutar, xuddi men kabi! Kabutar «gu-gu» deydi. Biz uyimizga yo'lni hech qachon adashtirmaymiz.

items.image_prompt: An owl with big round eyes at night, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — boyqush. Uning ko'zlari katta-katta. Boyqush kunduzi uxlaydi, kechasi esa uchib, «hu-hu» deydi.

extra.matn: Qanotlarim — lip-lip, uchaman osmonga! Chirq-chirq — chumchuq, gu-gu — kabutar, hu-hu — boyqush! Qo'llarni qanotdek qoqib kuylaymiz!

lessons.name: Qush uyasi
lessons.goal: Bola qush uya qurishini va tuxum qo'yishini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bahorda qushlar shoxlardan, o'tlardan kichkina uy quradi. Ichida sir bor! Qanday sir ekan?

items.image_prompt: A bird's nest with eggs on a tree branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — uya, qushning uyi. Qush uni cho'plar, o'tlar va patlardan tumshug'i bilan quradi. Uya daraxt shoxida turadi.

items.image_prompt: Small speckled bird eggs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — tuxum. Qush uyaga tuxum qo'yib, ustida o'tiradi va isitadi. Keyin tuxumdan kichkina qushcha — polapon chiqadi!

items.image_prompt: A soft feather floating, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — pat. Qushning tanasi patlar bilan qoplangan. Patlar yengil va yumshoq, qushni sovuqdan asraydi.

extra.matn: Sayrda daraxtlarga qarang: uya ko'rinyaptimi? Uyaga tegmaymiz va qushlarni cho'chitmaymiz — faqat uzoqdan qaraymiz!

lessons.name: Suvda yashaydiganlar
lessons.goal: Bola baliq, kit, delfinni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men suvga kira olmayman, lekin suv ichida ham hayot bor! Kimlar suvda yashaydi? Keling, sho'ng'iymiz!

items.image_prompt: A fish swimming in a river, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — baliq. U daryo va ko'lda yashaydi. Baliq suzgichlari va dumi bilan suzadi. Suvdan tashqarida yashay olmaydi.

items.image_prompt: A big blue whale spouting water, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kit. U dengizda yashaydi va juda-juda katta, fildan ham katta! Kit tepasidan suv favvora qilib chiqaradi.

items.image_prompt: A happy dolphin jumping out of the sea, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — delfin. U dengizda yashaydi, juda aqlli va quvnoq. Delfin suvdan sakrab chiqib o'ynaydi va chiyillaydi.

extra.matn: O'yin! Men aytaman: qush bo'lsa — qanot qoqing, suvda yashasa — suzgandek qo'l siljiting. Chumchuq! Kit! Boyqush! Delfin!

lessons.name: Meva nima?
lessons.goal: Bola meva daraxtda o'sishini, shirin ekanini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bog'bon amaki savatga daraxtdan terilgan narsalarni yig'yapti. Ular shirin va xushbo'y. Nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: Apples growing on a tree branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mevalar daraxtda yoki butada o'sadi. Ular ko'pincha shirin bo'ladi. Olma, nok, o'rik — hammasi meva!

items.image_prompt: A juicy orange fruit, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — apelsin. U to'q sariq, po'sti qalin. Ichi bo'lak-bo'lak va sersuv. Apelsin issiq o'lkada daraxtda o'sadi.

items.image_prompt: A bunch of grapes on a vine, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — uzum. U tokda shingil-shingil bo'lib o'sadi. Uzumni quritsak, mayiz bo'ladi!

lessons.name: Sabzavot nima?
lessons.goal: Bola sabzavot polizda, yerda o'sishini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Endi polizga boramiz. U yerda narsalar yerda yoki yer ostida o'sadi. Ulardan sho'rva qilamiz. Nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: Carrots growing in garden soil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sabzavotlar polizda, yerda yoki yer ostida o'sadi. Ulardan sho'rva, salat va palov qilamiz. Sabzi — sabzavot!

items.image_prompt: Potatoes being dug from soil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kartoshka. U yer ostida yashirinib o'sadi. Kartoshkani qazib olamiz va pishirib yeymiz.

items.image_prompt: Red tomatoes on a green plant, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — pomidor. U kichik poyada o'sadi. Avval yashil bo'ladi, keyin quyoshda qizarib pishadi.

lessons.name: Savatlarga ajratamiz
lessons.goal: Bola meva va sabzavotni ajratadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Voy, mevalar va sabzavotlar aralashib ketibdi! Ikkita savat bor. Menga ajratishga yordam berasizmi?

items.image_prompt: A red strawberry, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — qulupnay. U yerga yaqin, pastda o'sadi, lekin shirin — shuning uchun meva deymiz! Bahorda pishadi.

items.image_prompt: A green cucumber on a vine, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bodring. U polizda o'sadi, yashil va qirs-qirs. Bodring — sabzavot, uni salatga solamiz.

items.image_prompt: A green bell pepper, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bulg'or qalampiri. U yashil, qizil yoki sariq bo'ladi. Ichi bo'sh, urug'lari bor. Bu — sabzavot.

extra.matn: O'yin! Chap qo'l — meva savati, o'ng qo'l — sabzavot savati. Men aytaman, siz qo'lni ko'tarasiz: olma! kartoshka! uzum! bodring! apelsin!

lessons.name: Issiq va sovuq
lessons.goal: Bola issiq va sovuqni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bir kun terlab ketamiz, bir kun titraymiz. Nega shunday? Keling, issiq va sovuqni bilib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: A child fanning themselves on a hot sunny day, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Issiq kunda quyosh qattiq qizitadi, biz terlaymiz va suv ichgimiz keladi. Issiq choy va sho'rva ham issiq!

items.image_prompt: A shivering child in the cold, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sovuq kunda qo'llarimiz muzlaydi, biz titraymiz: dir-dir-dir! Muzqaymoq va qor ham sovuq.

extra.matn: Kattalar bilan: bir stakanga iliq suv, boshqasiga sovuq suv quying. Barmog'ingizni tekkizing: qaysi biri iliq, qaysi biri sovuq? Juda qaynoq suvga tegmaymiz!

lessons.name: Quyoshli va bulutli kun
lessons.goal: Bola quyoshli va bulutli kunni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ertalab derazadan qaraymiz: osmon qanday? Bugun qanday kun ekan? Keling, ob-havoni bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A bright sunny day with a clear blue sky, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Quyoshli kunda osmon ochiq va ko'm-ko'k. Atrof yorug' va iliq. Sayr qilish uchun ajoyib kun!

items.image_prompt: A cloudy grey sky, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bulutli kunda quyosh bulutlar ortiga yashirinadi. Osmon kulrang, havo salqinroq bo'ladi. Balki yomg'ir yog'ar!

tests.q: Osmon ochiq va yorug' — qanday kun?

extra.matn: Har kuni ertalab osmonga qarang. Quyoshli bo'lsa — ☀️ rasm chizing, bulutli bo'lsa — ☁️ chizing. Hafta oxirida sanaymiz: qaysi kunlar ko'p bo'ldi?

lessons.name: Yomg'ir, qor va ko'lmak
lessons.goal: Bola yomg'ir, qor va ko'lmakni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bulutdan ba'zan suv tomchisi, ba'zan oppoq parcha tushadi. Keyin yerda suv yig'iladi. Bular nima?

items.image_prompt: Raindrops falling from a grey cloud, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yomg'ir — bulutdan tushadigan suv tomchilari: tip-tip-tip! Yomg'ir yerga, gullarga va daraxtlarga suv beradi.

items.image_prompt: Snowflakes falling on a winter day, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Havo juda sovuq bo'lsa, bulutdan yomg'ir emas, qor yog'adi. Har bir qor parchasi yulduzchaga o'xshaydi!

items.image_prompt: A child in rain boots near a puddle, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yomg'irdan keyin yerda suv yig'iladi — bu ko'lmak. Etik kiysak, ko'lmakdan «shalop» o'tamiz. Oyoq ho'l bo'lmasin!

lessons.name: Ob-havoga kiyinamiz
lessons.goal: Bola ob-havoga qarab kiyinishni biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qishda yupqa futbolkada chiqsak nima bo'ladi? Yozda qalin kurtka kiysak-chi? Keling, to'g'ri kiyinamiz!

items.image_prompt: A warm winter jacket, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kurtka. Sovuq kunda kurtka kiyamiz, u bizni isitadi. Kurtkaning tugmasini yoki zamogini oxirigacha yopamiz.

items.image_prompt: A pair of warm mittens, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — qo'lqop. Qishda qo'lqop kiyamiz, qo'llarimiz muzlamaydi. Qo'lqop bilan qor o'ynash ham qiziq!

items.image_prompt: A summer sun hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — panama. Yozda quyosh boshni qizdirib yubormasin deb panama kiyamiz. Issiqda panamasiz chiqmaymiz!

extra.matn: Rolli o'yin: tashqarida qor yog'yapti! Qo'g'irchoqqa nima kiydiramiz? Kurtka, qo'lqop! Endi quyosh qizitdi — panama kiydiramiz!

lessons.name: Kuz
lessons.goal: Bola kuz belgilarini biladi: barg to'kiladi, hosil yig'iladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Daraxtlar sariq-qizil kiyim kiydi, barglar raqs tushib yerga tushyapti. Qaysi fasl keldi?

items.image_prompt: Autumn trees with yellow and red leaves, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuz keldi! Havo salqin bo'ladi, tez-tez yomg'ir yog'adi. Barglar sarg'ayadi va qizaradi. Bolalar bog'chaga, maktabga boradi.

items.image_prompt: Colorful leaves falling from a tree, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuzda barglar daraxtdan uzilib, yerga tushadi. Ustidan yursak, «shildir-shildir» qiladi.

items.image_prompt: A basket full of apples, grapes and pumpkins, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuzda bog' va polizdan hosil yig'amiz: olma, uzum, kartoshka, qovoq. Savatlar to'la bo'ladi!

tests.q: Barglar ustidan yursak qanday tovush chiqadi?

extra.matn: Sayrda turli rangdagi barglarni yig'ing: sariq, qizil, jigarrang. Uyda ularni qog'ozga yopishtirib, chiroyli kuz rasmi qiling!

lessons.name: Qish
lessons.goal: Bola qish belgilarini biladi: qor, muz, chana
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Hamma yoq oppoq bo'ldi, derazalarda muz naqshlar paydo bo'ldi. Qaysi fasl keldi?

items.image_prompt: A snowy winter landscape with a snowman, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qish — eng sovuq fasl. Qor yog'adi, hamma yoq oppoq bo'ladi. Kunlar qisqa, kechalar uzun bo'ladi.

items.image_prompt: Ice cubes and a frozen puddle, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qishda suv sovuqdan qotib, muzga aylanadi. Muz sirpanchiq! Muz ustida ehtiyot bo'lib yuramiz.

items.image_prompt: A child sliding down a snowy hill on a sled, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — chana. Qishda tepalikdan chanada «vizz» deb sirpanib tushamiz. Juda quvnoq!

extra.matn: Kattalar bilan qiling: kichkina idishga suv quyib, muzlatgichga qo'ying. Ertasiga qarang — suv qotib, muz bo'libdi! Endi iliq joyga qo'ying — yana eriydi.

lessons.name: Bahor
lessons.goal: Bola bahor belgilarini biladi: maysa, gul, kamalak
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qor erib ketdi, quyosh iliq nur sochyapti, qushlar sayrayapti. Qaysi fasl uyg'ondi?

items.image_prompt: Spring tulips blooming in a green meadow, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahor keldi! Qor eriydi, havo iliq bo'ladi. Daraxtlar gullaydi, qushlar issiq o'lkalardan qaytadi. Bahorda Navro'z bayrami bor!

items.image_prompt: Fresh green grass sprouts, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahorda yerdan yosh yashil o'tlar — maysalar chiqadi. Hamma yoq yam-yashil gilamdek bo'ladi.

items.image_prompt: A rainbow over a spring garden, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahorda iliq yomg'ir yog'adi. Keyin quyosh chiqsa, osmonda rang-barang kamalak paydo bo'ladi!

tests.q: Qaysi fasl — gullar ochiladi, qor eriydi?
Yomg'irdan keyin quyosh chiqsa, nima ko'rinadi?

lessons.name: Yoz
lessons.goal: Bola yoz belgilarini biladi: issiq, mevalar, suzish
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Quyosh qattiq qizdiryapti, bog'da mevalar pishdi, bolalar suvda o'ynayapti. Qaysi fasl?

items.image_prompt: A hot summer day with a smiling sun, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yoz — eng issiq fasl. Kunlar uzun, quyosh kech botadi. Tarvuz, qovun, shaftoli pishadi. Bolalar ta'tilda dam oladi!

items.image_prompt: A child swimming happily in a pool, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yozda hovuzda suzib, salqinlaymiz. Suvga faqat kattalar bilan birga tushamiz!

items.image_prompt: A vanilla ice cream cone, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yozda muzqaymoq yeymiz — u sovuq va shirin! Lekin oz-ozdan yeymiz, tomog'imiz og'rimasin.

extra.matn: Kuzda barglar to'kilar, qishda qorlar yog'ilar, bahorda gullar ochilar, yozda quyosh qizdirar! Har faslga bitta qarsak — bir, ikki, uch, to'rt!

lessons.name: Gullar
lessons.goal: Bola atirgul, kungaboqar, romashkani taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men gulzor ustidan uchdim — qanday xushbo'y hid! U yerda turli gullar bor. Keling, tanishamiz!

items.image_prompt: A red rose with green leaves, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — atirgul. U juda xushbo'y va chiroyli. Lekin poyasida tikanlari bor, ehtiyot bo'lamiz — tegmaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A tall sunflower facing the sun, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kungaboqar. U baland o'sadi va boshini quyoshga qaratib turadi. Ichida pista — urug'lari bor.

items.image_prompt: A white daisy with a yellow center, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — romashka. Uning gulbarglari oppoq, o'rtasi esa sap-sariq, xuddi kichkina quyoshdek.

extra.matn: Gulzorda gullarni uzmaymiz — ular o'sib tursin! Faqat egilib, sekin hidlaymiz. Qaysi gul eng xushbo'y ekan?

lessons.name: Daraxt
lessons.goal: Bola daraxt, barg va archani taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening uyam daraxtda! Daraxt baland, uning tanasi, shoxlari va barglari bor. Keling, yaqindan qaraymiz!

items.image_prompt: A big green tree with a strong trunk, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — daraxt. Uning qalin tanasi, ko'p shoxlari va barglari bor. Daraxt bizga soya, meva va toza havo beradi.

items.image_prompt: Green leaves on a branch, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — barg. Yozda barglar yashil, kuzda sarg'ayib to'kiladi. Shamolda barglar shitirlaydi.

items.image_prompt: A green pine tree in the snow, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — archa. Uning barglari ignaga o'xshaydi va qishda ham to'kilmaydi — doim yam-yashil! Yangi yilda archani bezaymiz.

lessons.name: O'simlikka g'amxo'rlik
lessons.goal: Bola o'simlikka suv, quyosh va tuvak kerakligini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Derazada kichkina gul so'lib qolibdi. Uni qanday qutqaramiz? Unga nima kerak? Keling, bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A child watering a plant with a watering can, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'simlik ham chanqaydi! Unga suv beramiz — sug'oramiz. Lekin juda ko'p emas, ozgina-ozgina.

items.image_prompt: Sunlight shining on a potted plant by a window, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'simlikka quyosh nuri kerak. Shuning uchun gul tuvagini deraza oldiga qo'yamiz. Qorong'ida o'simlik so'liydi.

items.image_prompt: A potted green plant, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — tuvak. Unga tuproq solib, gul ekamiz. Uyda gullar tuvakda o'sadi va xonamizni chiroyli qiladi.

extra.matn: Tajriba: kattalar bilan bitta tuvakdagi gulni tanlang. Har kuni unga qarang, kerak bo'lsa ozgina suv bering. Bir haftadan keyin — yangi barg chiqdimi?

lessons.name: Mashinalar
lessons.goal: Bola yengil mashina va yuk mashinasini taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ko'chada «bip-bip» qilib kimdir o'tdi! Kimdir katta, kimdir kichik. Bular nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: A small red car on a road, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yengil mashina. U odamlarni tez olib boradi va «bip-bip» deb signal chaladi. Mashinada o'rindiqda o'tiramiz.

items.image_prompt: A delivery truck carrying boxes, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yuk mashinasi. U katta va kuchli, og'ir yuklarni tashiydi: mebel, qutilar, mevalar. U «g'uv-g'uv» deb yuradi.

extra.matn: Harakatli o'yin: hamma — mashina! Rulni ushlang va yuring. Men «tez!» desam — tez, «sekin!» desam — sekin, «to'xta!» desam — to'xtaysiz!

lessons.name: Avtobus va taksi
lessons.goal: Bola avtobus, bekat, taksini taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bekatda ko'p odam kutib turibdi. Mana, katta uzun mashina keldi! Hamma chiqdi. Bu nima?

items.image_prompt: A big yellow city bus, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — avtobus. U uzun va katta, ichida ko'p odam sig'adi. Avtobus bekatdan bekatga yuradi.

items.image_prompt: A bus stop sign, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bekat. Bu yerda avtobusni kutamiz. Avtobus to'xtaganda, kattalar bilan qo'l ushlab chiqamiz.

items.image_prompt: A yellow taxi car, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — taksi. Uni chaqirsak, bizni kerakli joyga olib boradi. Taksining tepasida chiroqcha bor.

extra.matn: Avtobusning g'ildiragi aylanar, aylanar! Eshiklari ochilar — shuv! Yopilar — shuv! Signal chalar — bip-bip! Harakat bilan kuylaymiz!

lessons.name: Poyezd
lessons.goal: Bola poyezd relsda yurishini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Chux-chux-chux! Uzun-uzun narsa relslar ustida yugurib kelyapti. U kim ekan? Keling, qaraymiz!

items.image_prompt: A cute train with carriages, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — poyezd. Uning ko'p vagonlari bor, ular bir-biriga ulangan. Poyezd «chux-chux» deb, uzoq shaharlarga boradi.

items.image_prompt: Railway tracks going into the distance, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — rels, poyezdning yo'li. Poyezd faqat relsda yuradi. Relsga yaqin bormaymiz — bu xavfli!

extra.matn: O'yin: bir-biringizning yelkangizdan ushlab, poyezd bo'ling! Oldindagi — lokomotiv, qolganlar — vagon. Chux-chux, jo'nadik! Bekat — to'xtaymiz!

lessons.name: Samolyot va vertolyot
lessons.goal: Bola samolyot va vertolyot havoda uchishini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men osmonda uchaman, lekin ba'zan mendan ham baland va tez kimdir uchib o'tadi! Vuuuv… Bu kim?

items.image_prompt: A passenger airplane flying in the sky, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — samolyot. Uning men kabi qanotlari bor, lekin juda katta! Samolyot «vuuuv» deb osmonda uchadi va odamlarni uzoqqa olib boradi.

items.image_prompt: A helicopter with spinning blades, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — vertolyot. Uning tepasida katta parrak aylanadi: tar-tar-tar! Vertolyot joyida turib, havoda osilib tura oladi.

extra.matn: O'yin! Yo'lda yursa — qo'lni pastga, osmonda uchsa — tepaga ko'taring! Mashina! Samolyot! Avtobus! Vertolyot! Poyezd!

lessons.name: Shifokor
lessons.goal: Bola shifokor kasbini va uning asboblarini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Qanotim og'rib qoldi. Kim menga yordam beradi? Oq xalatli mehribon odam! U kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A kind doctor in a white coat smiling, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — shifokor. U kasal bo'lganimizda bizni davolaydi. Shifokor oq xalat kiyadi va juda mehribon.

items.image_prompt: A thermometer, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — termometr. Shifokor u bilan tanamiz issiq yoki issiq emasligini o'lchaydi. Isitmamiz chiqsa, termometr bilib oladi.

items.image_prompt: A doctor's stethoscope, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — stetoskop. Shifokor uni quloqqa taqib, yuragimizni eshitadi: tuk-tuk, tuk-tuk!

extra.matn: Rolli o'yin: siz shifokorsiz, ayiqcha — bemor. «Salom, nima bo'ldi?» Yuragini eshiting — tuk-tuk! Isitmasini o'lchang. «Tez tuzalib keting!»

lessons.name: Oshpaz
lessons.goal: Bola oshpaz kasbini biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Oshxonadan palovning mazali hidi kelyapti! Oq qalpoqli kishi qozon oldida turibdi. U kim?

items.image_prompt: A cheerful chef with a white hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — oshpaz. U mazali ovqat pishiradi. Oshpaz oq qalpoq va fartuk kiyadi, ishlashdan oldin qo'lini yuvadi.

items.image_prompt: A pot of hot soup, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — qozon. Oshpaz qozonda sho'rva va palov pishiradi. Qozon juda issiq bo'ladi — unga tegmaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A plate of Uzbek plov with rice, carrots and meat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — palov. Unga guruch, sabzi, piyoz va go'sht solinadi. Palovni hamma yaxshi ko'radi!

extra.matn: Rolli o'yin: qo'lni yuvamiz! Qozonga sabzi soling, piyoz soling, guruch soling. Aralashtiring. Palov tayyor! Mehmonlarga tortamiz: «Yoqimli ishtaha!»

lessons.name: Haydovchi
lessons.goal: Bola haydovchi kasbini va svetoforni biladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Avtobusni kim boshqaradi? U bizni bog'chaga, bozorga, uyga olib boradi. Keling, tanishamiz!

items.image_prompt: A friendly bus driver at the steering wheel, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — haydovchi. U rulni burab, mashina yoki avtobusni boshqaradi. Haydovchi yo'lga diqqat bilan qaraydi.

items.uz: yo'l chirog'i: qizil — to'xta, yashil — yur
items.image_prompt: A traffic light with red, yellow, green lights, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — svetofor. Qizil yonsa — to'xtaymiz, yashil yonsa — yuramiz. Haydovchi ham, biz ham svetoforga bo'ysunamiz.

items.image_prompt: A child sitting in a bus seat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Avtobusda ketayotgan odam — yo'lovchi. Yo'lovchi tinch o'tiradi, haydovchini chalg'itmaydi va tutqichdan ushlaydi.

extra.matn: O'yin! Men qizil doira ko'rsatsam — joyingizda to'xtang. Yashil ko'rsatsam — joyingizda yuring! Qizil! … Yashil! … Qizil!
